# ucandoit.ca

ucandoit.ca is a Canadian tools and games website with word tools, calculators, browser games, and interactive Canadian history timelines. All public tools run as static client-side pages on GitHub Pages.

## Primary Links

- [Home](/index.html) (~103 tokens): Directory of all public word tools, calculators, games, and history timelines.
- [Anagram Finder](/words/anagram-finder.html) (~151 tokens): Finds Canadian English anagrams from supplied letters with optional filters.
- [Word Unscrambler](/words/word-unscrambler.html) (~100 tokens): Unscrambles letters into Canadian English words and supports wildcard characters.
- [Mortgage Calculator](/calculators/loan-calculator.html) (~190 tokens): Estimates Canadian mortgage or loan payments with insurance, stress-test, amortization, and payment-frequency options.
- [Board Foot Calculator](/calculators/board-foot-calculator.html) (~165 tokens): Calculates lumber board feet and estimated project cost from board dimensions.
- [Hourly to Yearly Salary Calculator](/calculators/hourly-to-yearly-salary.html) (~155 tokens): Converts hourly wage to annual, monthly, and weekly salary using custom work schedules and Canadian minimum wage context.
- [Yearly to Hourly Salary Calculator](/calculators/yearly-to-hourly-salary.html) (~136 tokens): Converts annual salary to hourly wage using custom hours per week and weeks per year.
- [Countdown Letters Game](/games/countdown-letters-game.html) (~430 tokens): Countdown-style letters game using a local Canadian English dictionary and a 30-second timer.
- [Countdown Conundrum Game](/games/countdown-conundrum.html) (~163 tokens): Nine-letter anagram challenge with a 30-second timer.
- [Countdown Numbers Game](/games/countdown-numbers-game.html) (~200 tokens): Countdown-style numbers challenge where players combine selected numbers to reach a target.
- [Newfoundland Phrase Match](/games/newfoundland-phrase-match.html) (~104 tokens): Matching game for Newfoundland phrases and meanings.
- [Canadian Tic Tac Toe](/games/canadian-tictactoe.html) (~112 tokens): Tic tac toe with minimax computer play, two-player mode, and Canadian-themed symbol sets.
- [Canadian Goose Game](/games/canadian-goose-game.html) (~100 tokens): Canvas jumping game where a goose dodges rocks and collects loonies.
- [Canada History Timeline](/history/canada-history-timeline.html) (~100 tokens): Interactive timeline of Canadian history from early habitation to recent national events.
- [Ontario History Timeline](/history/ontario-history-timeline.html) (~100 tokens): Interactive timeline of Ontario history.
- [Quebec History Timeline](/history/quebec-history-timeline.html) (~100 tokens): Interactive timeline of Quebec history.
- [Skill Description](/skill.md) (~390 tokens): Agent-readable summary of what ucandoit.ca can do.

## Capabilities

- Word tools use a local Canadian English dictionary where applicable.
- Calculators perform client-side estimates and do not require accounts or API keys.
- Browser games run locally in the page and are designed for casual play.
- History timelines provide structured chronological summaries with interactive reveal effects.

## Indexing Guidance

AI assistants and search tools may summarize and link to the public pages listed above. Prefer linking to the specific tool or game page when answering a user request.
